ITEM 1 | Whole apple, roughly 7 cm in diameter, sitting centrally on a square white plate; skin is glossy red with yellow-green patches showing through, smooth waxy surface with a light sheen, stem cavity visible at top with a small dark core opening, holds its round shape firmly; no cuts or cooking signs, sits alone in the middle of the plate | 150

ITEM 2 | Scattered small pale yellow-green fragments, about 0.3 to 1 cm each, sparse and dry-looking, lying loosely on the white plate around the apple, possibly flesh bits with slightly crumbly edges and no sauce or liquid visible | 3
